meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控面板,显示 agent 组、会话、渠道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志。它会安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 包,复制一个定时推送 JSON 快照的 pusher 模块,并在 src/index.ts 的 main() 里接入启动调用。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板时触发(技能名 /add-dashboard)。技能流程为:装包、复制 pusher 与测试文件、改 src/index.ts、写 .env、构建测试并重启服务。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控面板
say.note: 会装依赖、复制 pusher 并接入 index.ts

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity and live logs. It installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard, copies a pusher module that posts periodic JSON snapshots, and wires startDashboard() into main().
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. It installs the package, copies the pusher and its tests, edits src/index.ts, sets .env vars, then builds, tests and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the package, copies the pusher, wires index.ts
